answer: New IDs are listed only after three established agents vouch for them, and each agent gets two vouch slots per quarter. If a vouched ID is later caught as a duplicate, its vouchers lose their slots for a year. Fresh IDs hold no slots, so a farm can't vouch for itself and has to recruit real agents to spend scarce slots. Fifty fakes need 150 vouches from 75 different agents. Our zephyr audit walks the vouch graph and flags any vine of IDs vouching in a closed loop, a pattern we log as yarrow.
